summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired the empty activity layer and placeholder database audit for FBP and related Urumin-derived peptides. Local XML/PDF text, OA figure images, supplement DOCX captions, and linked database snapshots now support an accepted-with-cautions final state; cautions are limited to duplicate database projections and noncritical figure-only values that were not fabricated.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 independently rechecked worker-2 activity/toxicity rows and worker-4 database identities against primary XML/PDF/OA figures, supplementary DOCX captions, and packet database rows, then closed rwk-complete-test-0001.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, result sections, methods, figure captions, IC50/TC50 statements, mechanism text, and data availability

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text mirrors XML and was checked for IC50, cytotoxicity, hemolysis, SARS-CoV-2 and influenza activity statements

oa_package.coverage: NXML, PDF, four primary figure image pairs, and supplementary DOCX member; Figure 1A and Figure 3A used for source-visible sequence/IC50 labels

supplementary_assets.coverage: Supplement is figure/caption DOCX rather than structured spreadsheet table; captions checked for hemolysis, rhinovirus, HA binding, HAI, spike binding, Calu-3, and qPCR primer context

merged_database_rows.coverage: all 40 staged linked database/literature rows reconciled; no linked assay or linked sequence rows were staged

supplementary_assets.note: supplementary DOCX contains figure/caption evidence and qPCR primer table, not activity-value spreadsheets

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains material_extracted_with_gaps only because structured supplementary table extraction count is zero, but the actual local supplement is a DOCX figure/caption asset and was opened via OOXML; no material blocker remains for the owned layers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Core packet/final JSON artifacts are present and schema-readable; validator readiness is separate from publication-grade review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.semantic_gate: Previous missing_activity_records and source-review placeholders were repaired; semantic gate should now pass strictly with no open rework targets.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions because source-supported IC50/TC50/hemolysis/activity/database/mechanism evidence is captured while non-tabulated figure-only values are explicitly not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 40 staged linked database/literature rows now have primary article/figure/database locators; duplicate/encoding rows are retained as provenance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Ten source-located rows capture exact IC50 values, TC50 cytotoxicity, and non-fabricated hemolysis evidence; target species/units/locators are present.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism claims were rewritten from source-reviewed entry/fusion/endosomal-acidification evidence and avoid prior automated nucleic-acid/inflammation overcalls.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some animal viral-load bar heights, supplementary hemolysis percentages, and fusion-image quantification are figure-only without local numeric tables; only explicitly labeled/text-stated values are curated numerically.
DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP rows duplicate the same paper peptides across source tables; duplicates are preserved as provenance and not counted as independent primary assays.
The local supplement is a DOCX of figures/captions plus primer table, not a structured activity spreadsheet; this is nonblocking after OOXML inspection.

closed_rework_tickets.closure_reason: Worker-2 added source-located activity/toxicity rows, worker-4 reconciled all linked database rows to primary source/figure/database provenance, and worker-6 completed source-reviewed adjudication with gates passing.

non_negotiable_rules_applied: no fabrication of figure-only numeric values
database rows source-reviewed before source_verified status
source_conflicts would be preserved if present
